_doc: Numeric limits of the art bible (docs/ART-BIBLE.md, section 'Numeric limits'), measured by scripts/shots.mjs on the fixed shot set (scripts/lib/look-metrics.mjs). Lengths and areas are base pixels (the 480x270 grid). The before set exceeds the seam and flat limits on purpose: they are the target of epic 16, checked again in story 16.19.

longestSeamPx.note: longest unbroken straight colour edge in any shot (6 tiles)

largestFlatAreaPx.note: largest connected region of one 5-bit colour in any shot (16 tiles)

minWalkableLuminance.note: 5th percentile of the mean luminance of visible walkable tiles, night shots only (ids ending -night, outdoors)
